items.escena: A clay teenage girl at a home kitchen table happily stirring a pot of homemade soup, while a takeaway paper bag sits pushed aside, unopened, at the far edge of the table
A clay teenager in pajamas curled up on a sofa with a bowl of popcorn, smiling and politely waving no to a friend at the open door who is dressed up for a party
A clay girl in a helmet happily riding a bicycle past a long line of cars stuck in traffic, a small coin purse and a fresh green apple in her front basket
Two clay friends on a school bench: one excitedly holds up a skateboard, the other smiles warmly, raises one open palm and gently points toward a quiet chessboard beside her

items.texto: What do you prefer, X or Y?
items.escena: A clay boy holding up two picture postcards to his friend, one of snowy mountains and one of a sunny beach, while she taps her chin deciding
A clay student at a round classroom table speaking calmly with one hand resting on her chest, while three diverse classmates turn toward her and listen attentively
Two clay dogs standing side by side on a park path, one small and one clearly taller, and a child kneeling between them looking from one to the other
A row of five clay sunflowers in a school garden, the last one towering far above all the others, while a small child looks up at it with wide eyes
Three clay drawings pinned in a row on a classroom wall, each one better than the last: a rough pencil sketch, a neater coloured picture and a bright detailed painting with a small gold ribbon
A clay boy riding a bicycle wearing two helmets stacked one on top of the other, while a friend on the sidewalk laughs and points at the extra helmet
A clay girl standing on a plain podium block wearing two identical gold medals at once, one hanging over the other, while her coach shakes his head with a small smile
